feesNote: For children who are not related to the carer, Kent adds a weekly reward payment set by the child's age, with extra weekly skills payments for carers at Level 2 or Level 3 and a disability enhancement where it applies.
extras: A one-off £100 payment towards clothing and toiletries for newly arrived unaccompanied asylum-seeking children
Hourly rate of £13.21 for sessional work and day care
summary: Kent's 2026-27 rates, set by a Cabinet Member decision made in April 2026, pay a weekly maintenance allowance for each child across five age bands. Carers looking after children who are not related to them also receive a weekly reward payment, which is higher for children aged 9 and over, plus skills and disability payments where these apply.
